newsitem.title: USA: DuPont sets $100 mln expansion at UK plant.
newsitem.headline: DuPont sets $100 mln expansion at UK plant.

text.p: DuPont Co said Wednesday it plans to invest $100 million to expand capacity for Lycra elastane fiber at its manufacturing facility in Maydown, Northern Ireland, to support European demand.
Product from the Maydown expansion, which will result in a 30 percent capacity increase, is expected to be available in 1999, the company said.
DuPont said the expansion is part of DuPont's strategy to utilize its proprietary state-of-the-art production technology to increase capacity for Lycra response to growing global demand.

"Our intent has been and continues to be to install new capacity for Lycra consistent with market growth in support of our customers," said Dennis Reilley, vice president and general manager of DuPont Lycra.
